proposed_widenings.name: resource-less activated magic-item command
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation family requires an ActivationResource and RestResetCadence, but Folding Boat's command words are repeatable Magic actions with no use-count, charges, or recharge cadence.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This item also has three command words, each requiring a Magic action to use:

proposed_widenings.name: item destruction on transformed-form HP reaching 0
proposed_widenings.justification: The current ItemDestructionPolicy only models charge depletion. Folding Boat is destroyed when one of its vessel forms is reduced to 0 Hit Points, which is a different trigger tied to transformed object state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If either vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Folding Boat is destroyed.

proposed_widenings.name: container storage with unspecified capacity
proposed_widenings.justification: The current container_storage profile requires explicit weight and volume caps. Folding Boat can store items in box form, but the quoted rules text in this unit does not provide a numeric storage capacity to author honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: It can be opened to store items inside.

notes: alter_item_kind already covers box/rowboat/keelboat form changes, so this is not an atom gap. The honest blocker is surface shape: no unlimited command-word activation without a tracked resource, plus no destruction trigger keyed to vessel HP.
